Privacy Policy

How GWN Aura protects your data

At GWN Aura, your privacy and security are our highest priority. We are committed to safeguarding your personal and financial information with the most advanced security measures available.

🔐 Bank-Grade Encryption
All data transmitted between your device and our servers is protected with 256-bit military-grade encryption — the same standard used by leading financial institutions worldwide.

🛡️ Your Data, Your Control
We never share, sell, or rent your personal information to third parties without your explicit consent. Your data is used solely to provide you with the best financial experience.

✅ Regulatory Compliance
GWN Aura is fully compliant with all applicable financial regulations. We are NDIC insured and operate under strict regulatory oversight to ensure your funds are always protected.

🔍 Real‑Time Fraud Detection
Our intelligent monitoring systems detect and block suspicious activities in real time, giving you peace of mind with every transaction.

📧 Transparency & Trust
We believe in complete transparency. You can review our full data handling practices at any time. If you have questions, our support team is always available to assist you.

💎 GWN Aura — Built on trust. Secured for life.
